en.headline: Fish raft fire in Sai Kung’s Po Toi O injures man; vessels damaged
en.dek: A blaze at fish rafts near the minibus stop this morning produced explosions and thick smoke; firefighters and a fireboat extinguished it within about 50 minutes.
body: A fire broke out at fish rafts in Po Toi O, Sai Kung, on Wednesday morning, injuring one man and damaging vessels and structures. Police received multiple reports around 8.33am of fire at No. 1 and No. 2 fish rafts opposite the minibus stop, with some callers mentioning explosions and smoke from rafts, a squatter hut and boats.

Firefighters responded with two hoses and two breathing-apparatus teams while a fireboat directed water from the sea. The blaze was brought under control by about 9.22am. A man in his 60s injured a finger while trying to fight the fire; he received treatment at the scene and declined hospital admission.

Preliminary information indicated a fishing boat at the stern was using a rectifier to charge equipment when two explosions occurred. The owner was inside a raft hut, smashed a window and attempted to use a fire extinguisher. Several fibre speedboats were reported burned and some vessels sank. Police and fire services remained at the scene investigating the cause.

zh.headline: 西貢布袋澳魚排起火傳爆炸聲 一人手指受傷
zh.dek: 今早布袋澳一號及二號魚排起火，曾傳出爆炸聲及冒出濃煙，消防水陸兩路灌救，約50分鐘救熄，一名六旬男子救火時手指受傷。
body: 西貢布袋澳今早發生魚排火警。警方於約8時33分接獲多個報案，指小巴站對開一號及二號魚排起火，有人報稱寮屋及船隻着火，並曾傳出爆炸聲。
消防派出兩喉兩煙帽隊灌救，同時調派消防船在海面向現場射水。火勢於約9時22分救熄。一名年約60歲男子在救火時弄傷手指，經敷治後拒絕送院。
初步消息指，事發時一艘漁船在船尾以整流器為物件充電期間發生兩次爆炸，船主當時在魚排寮屋內，打破玻璃欲用滅火筒救火時受傷。火勢一度猛烈，波及其他船隻，部分纖維快艇被燒通頂並沉落海底。警方及消防正調查起火原因。
